# AMC Liquid Tabs

<!-- Generated by tools/build-templates.mjs from template.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**List Template** for Universal Theme · direction: motion · APEX 23.1+ · v1.0.0

Tab navigation whose indicator behaves like a drop of liquid: it stretches toward the hovered or focused tab through an SVG goo filter and snaps back to the current page, instead of the flat underline of classic tabs.

**Use it for:** Page-level or section tabs on a List region: switching between sibling pages such as Dashboard, Orders, Invoices and Reports, or the tabs of a record page. One level; sub entries are ignored.

## Install

- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, through the Builder):** App Builder > your app > Shared Components >
  Export/Import > Import `dist/legacy/amc_tpl_liquid_tabs.sql` (Component Export). It creates the
  template in Universal Theme and its Static Application File(s) in `amc-templates/`.
- **APEX 26.1+ (APEXlang):** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/themes/universal-theme/list-templates/amc-liquid-tabs.apx` and
  `dist/apexlang/shared-components/static-files/amc-templates/` into the app, add the entries from
  `dist/apexlang/static-files.snippet.apx` to `shared-components/static-files.apx`, then run the apexlang gates.

## Use

Create or pick a List (Shared Components > Lists), add a **List** region and set **Appearance > List Template** to **AMC Liquid Tabs**. In APEXlang: `componentAppearance { listTemplate: @amc-liquid-tabs }`.

List template for tab navigation. Each entry is a real link; the current entry gets aria-current=page. Attribute 1 is a count badge that is hidden when empty. With JavaScript the indicator is a liquid pill that stretches toward the hovered or keyboard-focused tab and returns to the current tab; without JavaScript, and under prefers-reduced-motion, the current tab shows a static pill and nothing moves. The strip scrolls horizontally in narrow containers, fades its edges while scrolling and scrolls the current tab into view. Template options: Solid pill fills the indicator with the primary color; Liquid underline turns it into a stretching drop under the label; Fill width spreads the tabs across the region; Large raises the tab height; No track removes the tray behind the tabs. Forced-colors mode shows the current tab with a system outline.

## List entry attributes

| Attribute | Meaning |
|---|---|
| A01 | Count badge |

## Template options

| Option | Class | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Solid pill | `amc-TLiquidTabs--solid` | The liquid pill uses the primary color and the tab on it switches to the primary contrast color. |
| Liquid underline | `amc-TLiquidTabs--drop` | Replaces the pill with a primary drop under the label that stretches between tabs; the tray becomes a hairline. |
| Fill width | `amc-TLiquidTabs--fill` | Tabs share the full width of the region, for two to five tabs. |
| Large | `amc-TLiquidTabs--large` | Taller tabs with larger text, for page headers and touch screens. |
| No track | `amc-TLiquidTabs--bare` | Removes the tray behind the tabs so only the liquid pill remains, for colored hero regions. |
